# Memory

**Class** · `ironwood.lang.Memory`

```java
public final class Memory
```

Explicit managed-heap collection. Allocation never schedules collection.

## Methods

<a name="member-collect-28--29-"></a>

### `collect()`

```java
public static void collect()
```

Completes marking and sweeping synchronously on the calling thread.
Collection never closes resources or invokes user cleanup. Preparation
failure throws OutOfMemoryError without reclaiming managed storage.
